Recommended usage:
• Background: #0a1210 / #12181a (deep forest black)
• Primary Text: #e8f0e8
• Accent 1 (Dim Yellow Jacket): #c4a84a / #b8a14a – use for CTA, highlights
• River/Trust Blue: #3a8fb7 / #5fb3d9 – links, secondary
• Moss Green: #5a7a3a / #7aa05a – success, nature
• Mist Gray: #a0b0b5 – secondary text

Developer Cheat Sheet

For your CSS / Tailwind:
:root {
  --forest-black: #0a1210;
  --deep-moss: #1a2a1e;
  --dim-yellow: #c2ad52; /* your jacket - muted */
  --river-blue: #4a9bc4;
  --mist-gray: #a8b8b0;
  --moss-green: #6a8a4a;
}

Grid positioning (0-1000 system to %):
left = x_min/10 %, top = y_min/10 %, width = (x_max-x_min)/10 %

Avoid text inside bbox + 3% padding.
Best practice: Put text in .safe zones marked green in images above.
